title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is out, and critics love it 🏁
subject: galacticracer
description:
Podracer, speeder bike or landspeeder? 👇

Star Wars: Galactic Racer from Fuse Games (founded by Burnout and Need for Speed veterans) and publisher Secret Mode launched October 6, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, from $59.99. It scored 88 on Metacritic on PS5, above every Battlefront and both Cal Kestis Jedi games; only 4 Star Wars games rate higher, the newest from 2003.

Sources: Steam store page, GamesRadar+ (Oct 2, 2026), Inven Global, Last Word on Gaming (Oct 6, 2026)
Game footage © Lucasfilm / Secret Mode.

scenes.text: The best-rated Star Wars game since 2003 is a racer.
Star Wars: Galactic Racer launched October 6 on PS5, Xbox and PC.
It scored 88 on Metacritic on PS5, beating every Battlefront game.
It's made by Fuse Games, founded by Burnout and Need for Speed veterans.
You race podracers, speeder bikes and landspeeders in a runs-based campaign across the Outer Rim.
